info.title: MeshTransit private browser login source contract
info.description: Private source only, not a deployed documentation endpoint or SSO enablement. Completed direct TLS 1.2+, exact configured Host and canonical origin-form targets are mandatory. POST requires exact HTTPS Origin, X-MeshTransit-Login: v1 and literal empty JSON object within 32 bytes. Authorization custody, Referer/CORS/provider/local-login fallback, encoded/alternate routing and query outside callback GET are forbidden. Total headers retain 16384-byte/64-field/128-value and existing cookie parser bounds. Each component owns finite caller-clamped transport deadlines and non-queuing capacity. Proof/cookie transport never substitutes for fresh durable Core authority; only protected completion may claim/exchange/issue. The reserved server is illustrative, never an operator or provider default.

post.summary: Prepare browser intent without creating authority
post.description: Shared source budget and current durable route admission precede fresh independent cookie/proof entropy. Issue only __Host-mt_login_init, Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict/Path=/, no Domain. Cookie handle never enters JSON/JavaScript. Intent lasts 60-300 whole seconds, not a Session or single-use durable claim.

200.description: No-grant independent intent proof and remaining whole seconds. Exactly one fresh initiation cookie; no provider token or identity.

Set-Cookie.description: Only host-only initiation intent, never a Core Session.

post.summary: Preview a Workspace invitation and bind it to the next sign-in
post.description: Shared source budget precedes the lookup. Answers only a pending, unexpired invitation: the Workspace, the inviter, the invited address and the role; anything else is 404 without detail. Issues __Host-mt_invite, Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax/Path=/, no Domain, lasting 10 minutes; the next sign-in completion in this browser accepts the invitation, only when the provider verified the invited address, and clears it. Grants nothing by itself.

200.description: The invitation a link names, and the invitation cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: Only the host-only invitation binding, never a Core Session.

404.description: invitation_unavailable: the link is unknown, used, revoked or expired.

post.summary: Release an authorization URL only after confirmed creation
post.description: Require initiation cookie AND fresh dedicated intent proof, rechecked after route admission and before release. Shared source budget, exact discovery and locked durable creation checks remain mandatory. Atomically create/audit/outbox before release; unconfirmed outcomes release no authorization URL or pre-auth cookie. Return JSON for explicit browser navigation, never an AJAX-followed redirect. Set a fresh host-only __Host-mt_pre_auth, Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax/Path=/, no Domain; expire initiation cookie. No Account/Principal/Session/membership grant.

200.description: Confirmed pending AuthTransaction only, not successful login. Authorization URL is sensitive transient transport, not a durable client credential.

Set-Cookie.description: Fresh host-only pre-auth handle and expired initiation cookie only; multiple Set-Cookie fields.

get.summary: Capture transient callback custody and redirect to the clean path
get.description: The process replaces this template path with the SAME validated dispatcher callback, never a query selector. No body. Query <=8192 bytes and <=8 unique bounded pairs; malformed/aliased names and provider token fields reject. Require exact RFC 9207 issuer, canonical 256-bit state and pre-auth cookie, and exactly one nonempty code (<=2048 bytes for capture) or bounded provider error. Error description/URI may accompany error but are discarded, never followed or echoed. Optional bounded session_state and other bounded provider diagnostics are discarded, never authentication. No code/state/query reaches active content, referrer, logs, metrics, traces or continuation location. Shared source/state budgets precede encrypted host-cookie capture. Capture is no-grant input, not possession verification, claim, exchange or Session issuance. Edge/BFF query suppression is a separate mandatory public-activation gate.

parameters.name: iss
parameters.description: Exact configured issuer. Never a fetched endpoint or trust selector.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Exactly one of code/error; duplicates, empty values and both/neither reject.

parameters.name: error_description
parameters.description: Error-only bounded diagnostic, discarded without reflection.

parameters.name: error_uri
parameters.description: Error-only bounded diagnostic, discarded and never fetched.

303.description: One zero-body clean redirect with encrypted transient callback cookie only. No authentication or browser receipt is acknowledged.

Set-Cookie.description: Only encrypted __Host-mt_login_callback, Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax/Path=/, no Domain; 30-120 whole seconds.

post.summary: Prepare intent bound to current pre-auth and encrypted callback cookies
post.description: Require BOTH cookies and exact same-origin channel input; no proof that does not yet exist. Shared source/state budgets and live capsule opening precede independent OS entropy. Return csrf_token/expires_in only. No Set-Cookie, claim, exchange or grant. Dedicated continuation intent is bound to the exact complete route/origin/current cookie pair and 30-120 whole-second lifetime; it is not initiation proof or authenticated browser possession. Safe security/budget headers may be staged before a closed failure; no blanket HTTP mapper is enabled.

200.description: No-grant fresh cookie-bound continuation intent; cookies are neither set nor renewed.

get.summary: Present a static clean read-only continuation page
get.description: No credentials required or opened; no proof, budget, provider/DB, claim or grant effect. Exact clean GET only, no query/fragment/body. Restrictive hash CSP permits only the embedded script/style and self-only fetch; no CDN, analytics/RUM, storage or dynamic HTML. History is replaced with the fixed clean path. One explicit accessible user activation performs exactly one protected prepare then complete POST; no automatic retry or navigation to a request/response-selected alternate path. Source script checks are not browser-engine/CSP acceptance.

Content-Security-Policy.description: Exact embedded script/style SHA-256 hashes; never unsafe-inline/eval.

head.summary: Return static continuation headers without body or effects
head.description: Same exact clean transport/navigation and safe headers as GET. No credential access, proof, budget, claim, exchange, Session or body. HEAD callback and HEAD other operations are not aliases.

200.description: GET-equivalent static safe headers only, zero response body.

post.summary: Revalidate and single-use claim before confirmed Session completion
post.description: Require pre-auth AND encrypted callback cookies AND dedicated fresh continuation intent. Delegate the complete joined pipeline, never syntax gate alone. Reverify durable state/browser possession and atomically single-use claim before one no-redirect/proxy TLS token attempt with original PKCE. Fresh exact issuer/subject, route/authority/provider/recovery/session generations and expiry precede audited atomic existing-subject Session issuance. No JIT/linking/email/IdP-role authority. Recheck original capsule/proof/result expiry immediately before response. A successful new bearer exists ONLY in host-only __Host-mt_session, Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax/Path=/, no Domain, with rounded-down intersected expiry. Clear exactly pre-auth, callback and initiation cookies. No refresh or retry after ambiguous delivery.

200.description: Confirmed fresh Core Session only. JSON has fixed local return_path, never bearer/provider/identity data. Multiple Set-Cookie fields replace Session and clear three transient scopes.

Set-Cookie.description: Confirmed new Session and exactly three expired transient cookies; each field <4096 bytes.

403.description: Confirmed generic provider denial, no new Session. Clear exactly three transient cookies; never erase an existing Session.

loginInitiationCookie.name: __Host-mt_login_init
loginInitiationCookie.description: One canonical independent nonzero 256-bit handle. Intent only, never state, identity or Session.

loginIntentProof.name: X-MeshTransit-CSRF
loginIntentProof.description: One canonical bounded raw base64url initiation envelope, purpose-separated exact cookie/route/origin/key/time HMAC. Must accompany initiation cookie; never a grant or continuation proof.

preAuthCookie.name: __Host-mt_pre_auth
preAuthCookie.description: One canonical independent 256-bit pending browser handle. Shape alone is not authenticated possession; durable digest revalidation is mandatory at completion.

capturedCallbackCookie.name: __Host-mt_login_callback
capturedCallbackCookie.description: One canonical <=3800-byte AES-256-GCM encrypted transient callback envelope bound to exact route/key/epoch/current pre-auth cookie and live expiry. Replayable no-grant custody until durable single-use claim.

continuationIntentProof.name: X-MeshTransit-CSRF
continuationIntentProof.description: One canonical bounded raw base64url continuation envelope. Independent purpose/key from initiation; exact current cookie pair/route/origin/time HMAC. Require with BOTH cookies, never an OR alternative or authenticated grant.

LoginOrigin.name: Origin
LoginOrigin.description: One exact configured HTTPS Origin. Missing/null/foreign or duplicate Origin fails; forwarded values/Referer never replace it.

LoginIntentProof.description: Encoding shape only, not a MAC/time/cookie verification. Initiation and continuation use distinct independently bound purposes.

authorization_url.description: Transient exact allowlisted provider authorization URL; never store/log/trace or treat as a Session.

return_path.description: Exact canonical Core-owned local mapping, no auth loop/query/fragment/encoding/backslash/external authority. Browser navigates only when it equals its embedded mapping.

LoginHTTPDenied.description: Existing initiation owner's generic HTTP denial. No raw dependency/input diagnostic, authorization URL or new credential. Delivery failure may occur after partial output; never rewrite or retry.

LoginHTTPLimited.description: Existing shared source budget denial; no authority or provider/creation effect.

Retry-After.description: Bounded whole seconds supplied by a valid shared decision.

LoginDispatchFailure.description: Private dispatch rejects malformed/unknown method/target or cancellation before delegation without response mutation. No blanket mapper is enabled. A normally returning initiation delegate may already have produced a generic HTTP error, not successful login or receipt. Never append/replace/retry an uncertain response.

LoginPrivateFailure.description: Preserve the component's closed pre-release failure with no invented status/body/cookie or error mapper. Existing safe security/budget headers may have been staged by subordinate admission. Once submission begins, error/short write can follow partial delivery; never infer non-commit, roll back, retry or rewrite. A committed undisclosed Session follows ordinary expiry/revocation.

LoginContinuationPrepareFailure.description: Closed prepare failure may stage safe security/budget headers before returning, but no blanket HTTP status/body/cookie mapper is enabled. A write failure may follow partial proof delivery. Never retry, rewrite, reflect private error text or infer an authentication/commit result.
